purpose: Closed list of failure signatures for the learning loop. execution-record.py learning-assessment accepts only these ids; a new id is added through homeostasis so the same failure is not filed under different names.

signatures.description: A derived status (active plan, record pass, 'fixed' in a table) claims more than its source evidence shows.
A source fact changed but documents, fixtures, or scenarios restating it were not updated.
signatures.guardLimit: anchors and role tests cover known restatements only

signatures.description: A list with a canonical source (role files, scenarios, signatures) is copied into code and drifts.
A tool argument's allowed values, or its absence, is read as the limit of what the host can do.
signatures.guardLimit: covers the model list and role effort cases; the reasoning error itself needs review

signatures.description: Injected guidance is changed without a before/after replay of the scenarios it governs.
signatures.guardLimit: cap and anchors catch deletion and growth, not behavior; the replay itself is still a manual step

signatures.description: A new tooling command ships without its functional-assurance entry.
A conclusion is stated for a population its sample does not cover (small replay tasks taken for all work, one document category taken for all rule documents).
signatures.guardLimit: a reasoning error; review must ask what the sample covers

signatures.description: A gate that runs only when the agent declares it applies is bypassed by not declaring it.
